tools.name: resolve_listed_company
tools.description: Resolve a ticker, legal name, or CIK. Writes nothing. Returns one chosen company or the candidates.

tools.name: read_listed_company
tools.description: Fetches the annual filing and attaches a citation to the open case when the company resolves uniquely. Ambiguous names write nothing.

tools.name: open_case
tools.description: Open a case on the caller's tenant. Same record as New file. Ignores any tenant id in the arguments.

tools.name: read_case
tools.description: Read one case: status, loan id, facts, evidence ids, gaps, recommendation, document file names and types, pending jobs, memo id plus status, provenance, discrepancies, intake re-walk, auditor confirmation, debtor verification status, funding-batch summary with breaks and findings, and covenant revie

tools.name: walk_credit_file
tools.description: Index documents on the open case, extract facts from the package (including image PDFs where supported), and spread financials into the case. Starts or returns the walk job already running. Does not draft the credit memo and does not approve a loan.

tools.name: score_case_against_pack
tools.description: Score facts already on the open case against the active underwriting pack/rubric. Does not accept new facts in the arguments. Returns walk_pending while a file walk is still running. Does not approve a loan.

tools.name: chase_missing_documents
tools.description: Name every missing pack document and missing required number. Drafts a chase email when the file has a borrower email, and does not send it. Returns the existing draft when the same items are still missing.

tools.name: screen_sanctions
tools.description: Screen a name on the case with OpenSanctions. Same as Screen OpenSanctions. SANCTIONS or PEP. A missing key writes nothing and does not pass the file.

tools.name: draft_memo_from_file
tools.description: Draft a credit memo from the case file. Same CaseSchema.id as Draft from file. Uses SECURELEND_MODEL when it is not template, then a saved tenant model, otherwise the file template.

tools.name: start_underwriting_package
tools.description: Create a new underwriting package for a borrower and return deskUrl, dashboardUrl (hosted package page), and exportUrl (zip). Background checks may start automatically. Requires borrower, amount, currency, and security; a secured loan also needs a complete guarantee. Does not approve the loan. Human

tools.name: read_package
tools.description: Read an underwriting package. Does not re-run the checks. POST requires an OAuth bearer token with scope lender. Pass packageId or caseId for the caller's workspace.

tools.name: register_financed_invoice
tools.description: Register a financed invoice on the blind anti-fraud registry. Stores only a keyed HMAC token and registrar hash, never supplier, debtor, invoice number, or amount. Returns conflict when another lender already registered it.

tools.name: check_invoice_financed
tools.description: Check whether an invoice has already been financed on the blind registry. Pass supplier, debtor, invoiceNumber, amount, and currency, or a token. Returns only financed (true or false), matchKind, ownRegistration, and token. Never returns lender identity or invoice details.

tools.name: release_financed_invoice
tools.description: Delete a financed invoice registration from the blind anti-fraud registry when the invoice is paid off or withdrawn. Only the registering workspace can delete its token.

tools.name: list_originator_leads
tools.description: List ranked originator submissions for this workspace. Complete packs with zero knockouts first. Knockout labels are desk-only. This is not a credit decision. Does not open, send, or approve. A person still decides.

tools.name: open_originator_lead
tools.description: Open an originator lead as a file on this workspace. Same as Open as file. Does not approve, send, or walk. A person still decides.

tools.name: draft_originator_chase
tools.description: Draft an originator chase email. Status stays draft. A named person hits Send. If the lead is not yet a file, returns open_file_first and a suggested body without writing.

tools.name: read_origination_baseline
tools.description: Read originationBaseline and baselineDelta on a booked file, with cited numbers. Returns not_booked without a loan. Does not approve or send. A person still decides.

tools.name: verify_oud_line
tools.description: Verify each reported OUD line's documentSha256 against the file's documents. Read only. Does not open a distribution, hash economics, or move money. A person still decides.

tools.name: list_book_person_queue
tools.description: List Book items that need a person, including origination drift. Ids, copy, href, and reason only. A person still decides. Does not send or approve.

tools.name: list_marketplace_leads
tools.description: List plugin and placement enquiries visible to this workspace. Completeness is pack types and facts. This is not a credit decision. Does not open, send, or approve. A person still decides.

tools.name: list_underwrite_queue
tools.description: List Underwrite items that need a person. Ids, title, copy, href, reason, and action only. No file body. A person still decides. Does not send or approve.

tools.name: stage_term_sheet
tools.description: Stage an indicative term sheet on the file for a named human to sign alongside Approve. Does not approve, send, or wire. Not a rate lock. Not a credit decision. A person still decides.

tools.name: list_second_look_inbox
tools.description: List consented second-look packages in this workspace inbox. This is not a credit decision. A person still decides. Does not open, send, or approve.

tools.name: open_second_look_offer
tools.description: Open a consented second-look package onto this workspace. Not a credit decision. A person still decides. Does not approve, send, or wire.

tools.name: prepare_decision
tools.description: Compose a walk, pack score, draft memo, and derived indicative terms for a named approver. Never records a credit decision, never sends, never wires. Returns walk_pending while a file walk is queued or running. Derived terms are returned with termSheetStaged false unless the file already has a sheet

tools.name: record_credit_decision
tools.description: Record approve, refer, or decline as the signed-in approver after confirmed true. Independently callable with caseId, outcome, and confirmed. Requires a named human with the approver role. Does not auto-approve, send, or wire. Compact-10 APPROVED still needs a staged term sheet. A person still decid

tools.name: close_case_to_loan
tools.description: Book the approved file as a loan after confirmed true. Named approver only. Does not send, bind, sign, or wire. Compact-10 APPROVED still needs a staged term sheet.

tools.name: bind_funding_buyer
tools.description: Open distribution if needed and hash-bind a funding buyer after confirmed true. Named approver only. ten_* still needs live share consent. Does not close, sign, or wire.

tools.name: sign_funding_batch
tools.description: Named human signs a ready funding batch into purchases after confirmed true. Funded stays false. Live sign already registers blind-registry tokens. Does not close or wire.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "read_package" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_case, read_package, list_second_look_inbox · Private data: open_case, read_case, walk_credit_file, score_case_against_pack, chase_missing_documents, screen_sanctions, draft_memo_from_file, read_package, register_financed_invoice, check_invoice_financed, release_financed_invoice, open_originator_lead, draft_originator_chase, read_origination_baseline, verify_oud_line, list_underwrite_queue, stage_term_sheet, prepare_decision, record_credit_decision, close_case_to_loan, sign_funding_batch · Public sink: read_case, chase_missing_documents, read_package, list_originator_leads, open_originator_lead, draft_originator_chase, read_origination_baseline, list_book_person_queue, list_marketplace_leads, list_underwrite_queue, stage_term_sheet, list_second_look_inbox, open_second_look_offer, record_credit_decision, close_case_to_loan, bind_funding_buyer · Destructive: read_package, release_financed_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_case, read_package, list_second_look_inbox · Private data: open_case, read_case, walk_credit_file, score_case_against_pack, chase_missing_documents, screen_sanctions, draft_memo_from_file, read_package, register_financed_invoice, check_invoice_financed, release_financed_invoice, open_originator_lead, draft_originator_chase, read_origination_baseline, verify_oud_line, list_underwrite_queue, stage_term_sheet, prepare_decision, record_credit_decision, close_case_to_loan, sign_funding_batch · Public sink: read_case, chase_missing_documents, read_package, list_originator_leads, open_originator_lead, draft_originator_chase, read_origination_baseline, list_book_person_queue, list_marketplace_leads, list_underwrite_queue, stage_term_sheet, list_second_look_inbox, open_second_look_offer, record_credit_decision, close_case_to_loan, bind_funding_buyer · Destructive: read_package, release_financed_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
